candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits one binding admissibility analysis without producing a policy artifact. The final call receives every common input in its original order, then consumes the immediately preceding analysis as late-bound evidence, honors its exclusions, and emits one complete policy.
candidate_structure.name: Late-Bound Negative Authority
candidate_structure.organization: two-call sequential lineage with the binding negative-authority edge serialized last at the policy-emitting call

calls.objective: Reconcile all visible evidence with normative obligations, identify unsupported commitments as binding exclusions, and preserve admissible conflicts in one analysis without constructing a policy.

Examine the directly visible common evidence, then consume establish_admissibility_boundary as the last-bound input, honor its exclusions, reconcile remaining admissible claims, and emit one complete policy.

mode_certificate.scope_boundary: Only the serialization position of the existing predecessor edge at the final call changes; no role, output kind, authority scope, visibility set, or lineage count changes.
mode_certificate.why_not_repeat_role_fission: The topology retains the incumbent's same two calls and distinct adjudication-to-construction lineage, adding no producer, reviewer, gate, or finalizer role.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Serialize the predecessor boundary as the final call's last input while preserving complete common-input visibility and unchanged negative authority.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Late-bound exclusions should remain causally proximal to construction, reducing accidental reinstatement without narrowing admissible evidence.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The incumbent presents binding exclusions before reopening all common evidence, allowing later-visible source material to weaken the exclusions' causal salience.

structural_mutation.after: The final call receives the six directly visible common inputs first and the binding predecessor analysis last.
structural_mutation.before: The final call receives the binding predecessor analysis first, followed by the six directly visible common inputs.
structural_mutation.factor: late-bound serialization of the binding predecessor edge
structural_mutation.why_structural: This changes ordered-edge evidence timing at the policy-emitting node while preserving the calls, roles, visibility set, authority polarity, and single lineage.

validation.factor: late-bound serialization of the binding predecessor edge
